name: Copy of Remix Remix Forsa-T Geofenced Deals Platform
description:
Forsa‑T Marketing Website
Description:
Public responsive marketing and SEO website for Forsa‑T. Includes landing page, deals, businesses, categories, about, contact, FAQ, privacy policy, and terms.
Forsa‑T Consumer App
Description:
Responsive consumer PWA for discovering nearby geofenced deals, viewing businesses, following businesses, receiving notifications, and managing redemption history.
Forsa‑T Business Owner Portal
Description:
Business Owner dashboard for managing business profiles, branches, staff, deals, redemptions, subscriptions, billing, notifications, and analytics.
Forsa‑T Admin Dashboard
Description:
Administrative dashboard for managing users, businesses, deal approvals, categories, subscriptions, reports, notifications, and platform content.
Forsa‑T Super Admin Dashboard
Description:
Super Admin dashboard for managing administrators, roles, permissions, regions, platform configuration, security settings, audit logs, and overrides.
Forsa‑T Backend and Database
Description:
Backend API and PostgreSQL 16 with PostGIS database for authentication, users, businesses, branches, deals, geofencing, redemptions, notifications, subscriptions, and analytics.
